question: Under the actual 120-second rolling market-feature window, can every same-path executed-entry mismatch be assigned by the frozen V11 attribution priority while transport and account provenance remain gap-safe?

methodologyBoundary.reason: The first V11 run proved clean Helius transport but was invalid because the preregistered 60-second transport recovery exclusion did not match the runtime's 120-second PUMP_MOMENTUM_WINDOW_MS.

transportComparability.rawComparableRule: The socket is open and subscription-ACK ready, the mint state was refreshed in the current connection epoch, no gap is active, and no recovered gap intersects the trailing 120-second market-feature window.
transportComparability.cumulativeFeatureGapCaveat: The 120-second exclusion matches PUMP_MOMENTUM_WINDOW_MS and protects rolling trade-window features. It cannot reconstruct a trade missed from lifetime or first-reference features such as the sniper window; reconnect cohorts must remain separately visible when interpreting those diagnostics.
transportComparability.accountComparableRule: Any selected websocket account update must come from the current inspectable web3 transport generation; HTTP initial snapshots remain independently provenance-labeled.
transportComparability.lifecycleRule: Every socket-open epoch must ACK logsSubscribe. Unexpected reconnects and cumulative gaps must remain within the frozen bounds, every gap must close, and gap-affected comparison rows must remain visible but incomparable.
transportComparability.duplicateRule: Exact slot-signature notification duplicates are counted and suppressed before shadow-state ingestion; out-of-order notifications are counted and source-attributed.

classifierEpoch.primaryCauseSelection: Inherit the frozen V11 cause priority after V12 comparability exclusions.
classifierEpoch.contributingCausePolicy: Record every detected contributing cause even when only one primary cause grades attribution.

nextIfPass: Keep Helius report-only and repeat under the unchanged V12 contract before proposing provider routing or strategy consumption.
nextIfFail: Fix only the demonstrated V12 instrumentation defect. Do not change strategy, freshness bounds, gates, exits, capacity, or provider routing.
